definitions.explanation: Describes produce or farming methods that do not use chemical pesticides. Often used as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {無農薬|むのうやく}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}っている→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無農薬|むのうやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}している→栽培する：09860_saibaisuru⟧。
examples.english: This farmer grows rice without pesticides.

examples.japanese: {無農薬|むのうやく}⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Pesticide-free farming takes more effort, but offers higher safety.

notes:
{無農薬|むのうやく} means grown or produced without the use of chemical pesticides. Often used as a modifier (⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective) before nouns.

FORMS:
⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧ (agricultural chemicals/pesticides).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無農薬|むのうやく}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: pesticide-free vegetables
- {無農薬|むのうやく}⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧: pesticide-free cultivation
- {無農薬|むのうやく}⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: pesticide-free rice
- {無農薬|むのうやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to grow without pesticides

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無農薬|むのうやく}: specifically no pesticides (narrower meaning)
- ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧: organic (broader — also covers fertilizers, soil management, and certification standards)
- {減農薬|げんのうやく}: reduced-pesticide (uses fewer chemicals but not zero)
